name: Ikemen Senshuuraku
source:
Koyomi of the Hakkeyoi HS sumo club is having a crisis of doubt. "Why is sumo so popular?" he wants to know. This world hides a much older story. "Enter the ring. So that you can know how the story ends." NGS Project's distinctive sumo Otome Game has many endings, but which last days are the true ones?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ170679.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Hakkeyoi HS相扑俱乐部的Koyomi正面临着怀疑危机。“为什么相扑如此受欢迎？”他想知道。这个世界隐藏着一个更古老的故事。“进入擂台，这样你就能知道故事的结局。” NGS Project独特的相扑乙女游戏有很多结局，但哪些最后的日子才是真正的结局呢？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ170679.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
